Company description: QCOM (Generated via gemini-3.5-flash-lite)

Qualcomm Incorporated, trading under the ticker QCOM, is a multinational semiconductor and telecommunications equipment company that designs and markets wireless technology products and services. Founded in 1985 by Irwin Jacobs and a team of colleagues, the San Diego-based company played a pioneering role in the commercialization of Code Division Multiple Access (CDMA) digital wireless technology, laying the foundational framework for modern cellular communications. Over the decades, Qualcomm has evolved into the world's leading developer of wireless semiconductor solutions, holding a vast portfolio of essential patents for 3G, 4G, and 5G standards. Its core business centers on licensing intellectual property and manufacturing advanced mobile processors and modems, most notably the Snapdragon system-on-chip platforms that power a vast majority of the global smartphone market. In recent years, Qualcomm has strategically diversified its operations beyond mobile handsets, applying its high-performance, low-power computing technologies to automotive platforms, the Internet of Things, extended reality, and personal computing. Through continuous innovation in wireless connectivity and edge artificial intelligence, Qualcomm remains a central driver of the global digital economy.
